effective.basis: TCG release of Tournament Pack 7 (TP7-EN015), the first printing carrying the "was sent to your Graveyard this turn ... once during this turn" text

changes.historical_text: You can only use this card's effect once, and only during this turn. When a monster on your side of the field is sent to your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.modern_text: If a monster on your side of the field was sent to your Graveyard this turn, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck once during this turn. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Functional erratum in both retroactivity and usage window. Under the era text ("When a monster on your side of the field is sent to your Graveyard, you can Special Summon ...") the goat script registers, at resolution, a forward-looking `EVENT_TO_GRAVE` watcher plus an EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_F on a custom event, so only a monster sent to the Graveyard AFTER Last Will resolves counts, the Summon is offered as a forced trigger at that exact moment, and `e:Reset()` runs before the yes/no prompt so declining spends the effect. The TP7 text ("If a monster ... was sent to your Graveyard this turn ... once during this turn") is implemented by the modern script's global `EVENT_TO_GRAVE` flag, which makes a monster sent earlier in the same turn count and otherwise registers an EVENT_FREE_CHAIN continuous effect with `SetCountLimit(1)`, letting the controller Summon at any later legal point that turn.

gap.reason: Project Ignis ships no implementation matching this version: none of the upstream historical variants in the pinned databases carries this version's card text. Reproducing it needs a custom script and a reserved passcode.
gap.behavioural_impact: Period ruling package on top of the text change. Activation condition: the modern `s.spcon`/`s.activate` both require `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...)` before offering the Summon, while the goat `s.checkop2` prompts and consumes the effect regardless of whether a monster with 1500 or less ATK is in the Deck. Failed-search verification: the goat operation calls `Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)` when the selection comes back empty. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so this change is left unresolved.

review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v1 (SYE-031, Starter Deck: Yugi Evolution, 2004-03-01), which the goat cdb text matches exactly; v0 (SDY-039, 2002-03-29) predates the baseline and is not recorded. This is the one card in the batch where the functional erratum lands INSIDE the corpus window in a decisive way: TP7-EN015 released 2005-11-01, after the 2005-04-01 GOAT snapshot, so GOAT correctly takes the baseline goat script while any later period snapshot does not. Ordering rationale: the text erratum is anchored to a 2005 printing while the verification procedure is attested in force through 2011-02-02, so the functional change necessarily precedes the ruling change. IMPLEMENTATION GAP: the intermediate version - TP7 text played under the era ruling package - has no upstream implementation, so no correct script exists for a snapshot between 2005-11-01 and whenever the ruling package lapsed.
